verdict.line: You lose if you trade autos into his Q heal or get walled in after his level-6 Maiden comes online; you win by denying him before level 3 and bursting him in the windows his R is down.

brief.thesis: Yorick's Q (Last Rites) gives him free sustain on every melee exchange, and his E (Mourning Mist) actually out-ranges Jayce's Cannon-stance Shock Blast (700 vs 600), so the standard Jayce plan of poking safely from range doesn't apply here. That's why Yorick holds both the lane and solo-kill advantage at 46.2% over 2153 games — Jayce has to win with precise all-in timing instead of attrition.

theirWindow.when: right after he lands Q on you
theirWindow.what: He heals and his next auto hits harder, so continuing to swap autos in melee is a losing exchange — disengage with E (Thundering Blow) instead of matching hits.

yourWindow.when: before level 3, before his R exists
yourWindow.what: Poke in Cannon stance with Q (Shock Blast) since he has no wall pressure and no Maiden yet — this is the lane-control window OP.GG's own data points to.

boots.why: Yorick's damage is all physical and auto-attack-based through Q and his Maiden's empowered hits, so the flat reduction outvalues the CDR from Ionian Boots here.

runes.keystoneWhy: stacks through the extended melee exchanges Yorick forces and heals you back for it, directly offsetting his Q (Last Rites) sustain instead of losing the war of attrition.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is the measured best performer (48.1% over the other listed pairs), and the grievous wounds directly cuts the Q heal that makes Yorick's trades favored.

playing.title: Poke in Cannon before level 3
playing.detail: Use Cannon-stance Shock Blast to harass while he has no W wall and no R yet — this is the one window OP.GG's data flags as yours to take.

playing.title: Respect Mourning Mist's longer range
playing.detail: His E (Mourning Mist) reaches 700 range, farther than your Cannon Q's 600, so don't assume a poke war favors you — only fire when he can't answer with E first.

playing.title: Don't trade autos into Last Rites
playing.detail: His Q (Last Rites) is up every 6 to 4 seconds and heals him plus empowers his next hit — break off with Hammer-stance E (Thundering Blow) instead of matching auto for auto.

playing.title: Watch for Dark Procession walls
playing.detail: His W (Dark Procession) drops a destructible wall at 600 range that can cut off your escape or your Q (To the Skies!) leap path — back off before he's close enough to drop it on you.

playing.title: Avoid all-ins while Maiden is up
playing.detail: After level 6, his attacks against your target get bonus damage while the R (Eulogy of the Isles) Maiden is summoned — wait out the 160s (down to 100s at rank 3) cooldown or burst him before she arrives.

playing.title: Use the stance-swap speed to disengage
playing.detail: Hextech Capacitor gives a move speed burst on every weapon swap — use it to break line of sight from his wall-and-mist combo rather than trying to out-trade it.

playing.title: Build the 53.2% path in order
playing.detail: Tear of the Goddess into Youmuu's Ghostblade into Muramana into Voltaic Cyclosword is the measured strongest route — the mana ratios are what finally let you win a skirmish outright.

brief.patchCaveat: The build, runes, and the 46.2% head-to-head win rate over 2153 games are measured from live games on the current patch (16.19.1); the ability readings and trade-pattern advice are my own analysis, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Gain lane control before reaching level 3 by applying pressure strongly. Get rid of his (R) when you want to fight Yorick after reaching level 6.
